## Hello!

I'm Socorro, a data scientist and lifelong learner with more than six years of experience building data tools for science. I care about making research data open, reliable, and easy to reuse, and about helping people reach their Eureka moments when they learn to work with it.

As the database administrator for the [Neotoma Paleoecology Database](https://www.neotomadb.org/), I maintain the production database and public APIs, manage the cloud infrastructure, and automate things like minting DOIs for datasets. I also develop open-source software for the Neotoma community, including the [neotoma2](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=neotoma2) R package and the [DataBUS](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21797938) bulk-upload toolkit.

If I'm not coding, I'm most likely practicing Chinese martial arts.
